decisions.reason: Alibaba Model Studio's lifecycle index is retained for item-level January extraction so major Qwen/API changes are not missed merely because the collector normalizes this source as an index snapshot.
verification_targets: extract January-dated model/API items; verify model identifiers, modalities, availability status, chronology, and deprecation boundaries

decisions.reason: Anthropic's January news index is central for Cowork/Labs and Claude behavior-policy developments that define desktop agent surfaces and behavioral boundaries.
verification_targets: extract January Cowork/Labs and constitution-related items; verify exact dates, research-preview/product boundaries, agent execution surface, policy/training role, and availability

decisions.reason: DeepSeek's official update index is retained to establish whether a material January model/API event exists; a verified absence prevents retrospective release invention.
verification_targets: extract any January-dated model/API update and verify date, model identity, API behavior, availability, and technical significance

decisions.reason: Google DeepMind's index is retained for January Gemini/reasoning/research developments and for cross-checking the broader shift toward agents connected to real-world context.
verification_targets: extract January-dated Gemini, agent, reasoning, or world-model items; verify chronology, technical scope, evaluation attribution, and availability

decisions.reason: Gemini API release notes are retained as primary chronology for January model/API availability and should anchor model identifiers and preview/stable status.
verification_targets: extract January entries; verify exact model identifiers, dates, modalities, tool capabilities, preview/stable status, and deprecations

decisions.reason: Kimi's official history is retained to establish the January K2.5/agentic coding chronology and separate dated January capabilities from later living-document updates.
verification_targets: extract January K2.5/Kimi Code changes; verify exact date, multimodal/tool-use scope, agent-swarm or parallel-agent boundary if present, availability, openness, and later-edit contamination

decisions.reason: MiniMax's official news index is retained to determine whether January contains a significant model, multimodal, video, or agent-system release deserving inclusion.
verification_targets: extract January-dated releases; verify model identity, modality, agent/tool scope, availability, openness, and benchmark-claim attribution

decisions.reason: Mistral's official index is central for January Vibe 2.0 and related coding-agent developments.
verification_targets: extract January Vibe/Devstral items; verify chronology, terminal-agent architecture, subagent/skills behavior, model identity, availability, and benchmark attribution

decisions.reason: Z.ai release notes provide primary chronology for GLM-4.7-Flash and related January open/lightweight model changes.
verification_targets: extract January GLM releases; verify exact date, parameter/model identity, coding/agent scope, open-weight/license status, availability, and benchmark attribution
